minigame.label: Minigame
minigame.placeholder: Time for the Minigame in milliseconds

modifierList.label: Modifier
modifierList.hint: If either the roll result or the value returned by the expression is equal to or greater than the DC (using the higher value), the number of items gathered is modified according to the modifier expression. You may include a mathematical operator at the beginning of the modifier; if none is provided, a plus (+) is assumed by default. For example, *1d4 multiplies the number of gathered items by 1d4.

gatherer-actor-config.title: Gatherer Configuration
gatherer-actor-config.notes: In order to harvest a targeted token, create a macro with the following:

error.notGatherer: This is not a Gatherer Sheet. Please select a Gatherer Sheet and try again.
error.noDraws: There are no more resources to gather from this creature.
error.noJournal: There is no gathering spot associated with this token. Please select a token with a valid gathering spot and try again.
error.cantHarvest: Conditions to harvest this token are not met

resourcePath.name: Harvest Resource Path
resourcePath.hint: Path to check if harvesting is possible. For example for DnD5e, this would be 'attributes.hp.value' to check if the token is alive.

quantityPath.name: Quantity Path
quantityPath.hint: Data path to item quantity. Starting from 'system' (excluded). For example for DnD5e, this would be 'quantity'.

resourceValue.name: Harvest Resource Value
resourceValue.hint: Value to check if harvesting is possible. For example for DnD5e, this would be '0' to check if the token has no HP remaining.

migrateOnStartup.name: Migrate settings on startup
migrateOnStartup.hint: If enabled, the module will migrate journal data on startup. You can use the macro 'game.modules.get("gatherer").API.migration.showManualMigrationDialog()' to manually migrate your settings.
